model.name: Solinas et al. 2007 cerebellar Golgi cell, 5-segment morphology (GoCl, GoCModel_Basic)
model.citation: Solinas S, Forti L, Cesana E, Mapelli J, De Schutter E, D'Angelo E (2007). Computational reconstruction of pacemaking and intrinsic electroresponsiveness in cerebellar Golgi cells. Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience 1:2. doi:10.3389/neuro.03.002.2007 (cited in the README; the Crossref record lists only 'Solinas'). Related work by the repository author, not cited by the repository: Gurnani H, Silver RA (2021). Neuron 109(10):1739-1753.e8. doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2021.03.027
model.expected_behavior: 5 segments (soma d 27 um, three 3 um dendrites, 1200 um axon). Soma: Na 48, NaP 0.19, NaR 1.7, KA 8, KV 32, KM 1, BK 3, SK2 38 (ionChannelKS), HCN1f/HCN1s 0.05, HCN2f/HCN2s 0.08, CaHVA 0.46 (Nernst), CaLVA 0.25 mS/cm2 (Nernst, ion ca2); leak 0.021 mS/cm2. The harness applies no input (spontaneous activity). README: Solinas-morphology parameter sets give autonomous firing of 2-9 Hz; the model is unstable unless dt is 0.001 ms or lower. No OMV test or reference. Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Only licensed candidate with HCN1/HCN2 plus T-type Ca in a pacemaking cell (sag/rebound diversity). Low confidence: (1) the LEMS harness includes ../../Mechanisms/*.nml, which resolves outside the repository (the cell file includes the same channels with working paths); (2) CaLVA uses channelDensityNernst with ion ca2 while the ca2 species is commented out; (3) the harness writes to ../Data_OneGoC/, which is not in the tree; (4) GoC.cell.nml also contains its own network element; (5) no CI or OMV test; (6) README reports voltage runaway at larger dt, and the harness dt is 0.0025 ms. Needs jnml -validate and a trial run before any use. GPL-3.0 copyleft. Same original source as the Solinas soma cells screened out in sweep 1, but a different conversion.
